text:
taylor: Hi folks — baby born overseas on 2026-02-20, trying to add to benefits but we don't have a US SSN yet. We have the foreign birth certificate, the embassy birth registration letter, and the baby passport. We also missed open enroll. Can we add the baby and what docs are required?

irene (Benefits): Congrats Taylor! :tada: Birth is a qualified life event. We need proof of birth (foreign birth cert) + passport or national ID. SSN can come later, but we need an SSN/ITIN within 60 days after enrollment for recordkeeping.

noah (People Ops): Quick checklist: 1) Submit Add Dependent in HiBob, 2) upload the embassy birth registration + passport, 3) select change reason "Qualified Life Event - birth" and set event date to 2026-02-20. We'll mark it as pending SSN.

taylor: Thanks — is a passport + embassy letter sufficient to start coverage immediately or do carriers insist on SSN before medical starts?

irene (Benefits): Carriers generally allow provisional enrollment based on government ID + birth record. We'll enroll effective 2026-02-20 once we verify docs. If the carrier later requires SSN, we'll follow up. Please note dental/vision often enroll immediately; some medical carriers allow provisional.

taylor: If we enroll retro, how will payroll handle retro premiums? Don't want a surprise large deduction.

devin (Payroll): Retro premiums can be applied back to the birth date if Benefits approves. We can prorate over up to 2 payroll cycles on request. Payroll windows: 1-15 and 16-end. If docs are finalized before the payroll cutoff (15th for mid-month run) we can include retro in the next pay; otherwise it will appear in the following cycle. If you'd like the retro split, add a note in HiBob and tag @devin.

taylor: Also the baby won't have a SSN for a few months; is the ITIN an option for tax reporting?

irene (Benefits): ITIN is acceptable for dependent identification for benefits if you have it. If you plan to apply for ITIN, upload the application receipt; but note the carrier may still want SSN when available. We'll set the record to pending SSN/ITIN.

noah (People Ops): One more operational note: for foreign docs not in English, we need either certified translation or the embassy letter confirming the original doc. Looks like you have that, so should be fine.

taylor: Great. I submitted the HiBob change and uploaded passport + embassy letter. Note added: "SSN pending, please split retro over two paychecks if approved".

people-ops-bot: Automated: Enrollment change submitted by taylor — status: pending review. Ref: ENR-20260220-7744

payroll-bot: Automated: Reminder — retro deductions require Benefits final approval and payroll cutoff alignment. See payroll schedule in People Ops handbook.

irene (Benefits): Received the submission. We'll process provisional enrollment and escalate any carrier-specific SSN requirements. Expect confirmation in 2 business days. If carrier rejects for lack of SSN we'll notify and help with next steps.

taylor: Thanks everyone — really appreciate the quick help :pray:
